artifacts.producer: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
artifacts.registrationUniverse: First forenames on births registered in Northern Ireland, including births to resident and non-resident mothers.
artifacts.suppression: Counts below three are suppressed; '..' denotes a value below three and '-' denotes zero.
artifacts.cleaning: Boy and girl registration categories are summed. Published spellings remain distinct after Unicode NFC and surrounding-whitespace removal.

artifacts.registrationUniverse: First forenames on births registered in Scotland; stillbirths and Scottish-resident births outside Scotland are excluded.
artifacts.suppression: Counts of two or fewer within Scotland are suppressed.
artifacts.cleaning: Boy and girl registration categories are summed. NRS has already removed accents and applied its proper-case transformation; remaining text receives Unicode NFC and surrounding-whitespace removal only.
artifacts.intendedBands: Support-only 1996 and UK-wide registration-count-weighted bands for 1997-2024.

artifacts.publication: Baby names in England and Wales: 2024
artifacts.registrationUniverse: First names on live births occurring in England and Wales, including a very small number of late registrations under the release methodology.
artifacts.suppression: Names with counts below three in a registration-sex category are redacted as '[x]'.
artifacts.cleaning: Boy and girl registration categories are summed. Exact published spellings remain distinct after Unicode NFC and surrounding-whitespace removal.
artifacts.intendedBands: Support-only 1996 and UK-wide registration-count-weighted bands for 1997-2024.

artifacts.publication: Top 100 baby names in England and Wales: historical data
artifacts.registrationUniverse: Published top-100 first-name rankings for baby boys and girls in England and Wales at ten-year intervals.
artifacts.suppression: Only the top 100 names per registration-sex category are published; counts are unavailable before 1996.
artifacts.cleaning: Boy and girl support sets are combined without rank-derived weights. Exact published spellings remain distinct after Unicode NFC and surrounding-whitespace removal.
artifacts.intendedBands: Published-support-uniform midpoint bands for UK birth years 1906-1995.
